tokenTypes.allowedUse: Server-to-server control-plane bootstrap, configuration, and administrative service calls.
tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Browser exposure, user session auth, UCL per-connection events, usage ingestion.
tokenTypes.rotationNotes: Rotate per consuming app and update Railway/server secret managers together.

tokenTypes.allowedUse: Per-workspace or per-connection UCL link, status, and event calls.
tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Global bootstrap, browser exposure, Verixet usage ingestion, Stripe operations.
tokenTypes.rotationNotes: Rotate when a workspace app connection is revoked or repaired.

tokenTypes.allowedUse: App-scoped server usage event ingestion into Verixet.
tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Browser exposure, entitlement evaluation as a user, Stripe operations, XFlow UCL events.
tokenTypes.rotationNotes: Rotate per app and preserve idempotency/replay logs during cutover.

tokenTypes.allowedUse: OAuth user/session authorization and userinfo access.
tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Service bootstrap, billing webhooks, Stripe API access, DB access.
tokenTypes.rotationNotes: Use normal OAuth expiry/refresh handling; do not store as service secret.

tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Browser exposure, API bearer auth, unrelated service calls.
tokenTypes.rotationNotes: Rotate through OAuth client dashboard and Railway vars.

tokenTypes.allowedUse: Stripe API calls owned by Verixet billing authority.
tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Browser exposure or consumer-app billing authority unless a documented legacy/local mode is active.
tokenTypes.rotationNotes: Rotate in Stripe and Verixet Railway together; verify webhooks after rotation.

tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Browser exposure, outbound Stripe API auth, non-webhook routes.
tokenTypes.rotationNotes: Rotate webhook endpoints one environment at a time.

tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Browser exposure, public site key configuration.
tokenTypes.rotationNotes: Rotate in Cloudflare and app Railway environments; test keys/mock validation only outside production.

tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Browser exposure or unrelated API bearer auth.

tokenTypes.allowedUse: Server-side database access for the owning app database.
tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Browser exposure, cross-app authority writes outside documented mirror/cache rules.
tokenTypes.rotationNotes: Rotate through provider; verify migrations and connection pools.

tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Secret auth, DB/API access, raw secret logging.
tokenTypes.rotationNotes: Treat browser DSNs as public identifiers; keep auth tokens out of app env.

tokenTypes.allowedUse: Server-side signed media download URL generation/verification.
tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Browser exposure, user auth, billing auth.
tokenTypes.rotationNotes: Rotate with short overlap for existing signed URLs if needed.

tokenTypes.allowedUse: Server-side JWT/session signing where local app auth remains active.
tokenTypes.forbiddenUse: Browser exposure, cross-app service tokens, Stripe/OAuth secrets.
